findings.issue: Button text is light gray on a medium blue background, reducing legibility.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision will have difficulty reading the call-to-action text.
findings.recommendation: Increase contrast by using darker text or a darker button background to meet 4.5:1.

findings.issue: Navigation links are spaced too tightly and appear crowded.
findings.user_impact: Users may struggle to distinguish individual navigation targets quickly.
findings.recommendation: Increase horizontal space between links to at least 16px.

findings.issue: Footer links are not aligned to the same baseline.
findings.user_impact: The footer appears visually uneven and less polished.
findings.recommendation: Align footer links to the baseline grid used by the copyright text.
